subject: Startups
title: The VC Diversity Problem
description: A fast breakdown of The VC Diversity Problem for builders.

hook.text: Less than 2% of VC funding goes to female founders. For Black founders, it's less than 1%. The gap is enormous.

buildup.text: VC is built on pattern matching: invest in people who look like previous winners. That creates a homogeneity loop.

discovery.text: Research shows diverse teams outperform. First Round Capital found female-founded companies returned 63% more.

twist.text: New funds like Backstage Capital and Harlem Capital focus on underrepresented founders—and post strong returns.

climax.text: The VC diversity gap is slowly closing, but fixing decades of pattern matching will take sustained effort.

punchline.text: Funding the overlooked isn't charity. It's alpha.

quiz.question: What causes the VC diversity gap?
options: Pattern matching that favors people similar to past winners
